items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: John Veen on the drum. ... I had Magma Net on a piano, John Veen, old man, we called it Tar-kun for nickname. John Veen on a drum.

ctx.x: I was in 19, say 1920, at Fortify. And, uh, Manetto was on the piano and I was playing guitar. John Veen on the drum. And, uh, Tinette on the violin. We didn't have no trumpet, no. I had old man Willie Umprey on the clarinet. Uh-huh. Now, at that time, they didn't allow no, uh, blowing instruments in the district there. Oh, yeah. I'm the first man that put the blowing instruments there.
